# GrowthBook positioning & differentiators
Date: 2026-08-20 | Duration: 62m

## Summary
The team focused on identifying and refining three to four key differentiators for GrowthBook, emphasizing its developer-friendliness, open source nature, and warehouse-native architecture. Consensus was reached on important themes like flexibility, enterprise readiness, and innovation pace. Participants actively voted on differentiators, resulting in strong preferences for flexibility and AI-native capabilities. The discussion also highlighted the importance of deep customer partnerships and trust, along with a transparent pricing model that appeals to both enterprise clients and smaller users. AI was framed as a tool to enhance experimentation efficiency while retaining user control. Lastly, there was a commitment to create consistent messaging to support sales enablement and address both developer and non-technical user needs.

## Keywords
GrowthBook, differentiators, experimentation platform, developer-friendly, AI native, transparency, pricing flexibility

## Action Items

**Ashley Stirrup**
Lead follow-up working sessions with Elyse Fox and Scott Bailey to package and refine the elevator pitch and messaging pillars based on voting results and meeting insights (49:00)

**Elyse Fox**
Organize further discussions to elaborate on voting results, incorporate additional points discussed (e.g., modularity, partnership, transparency), and help draft the messaging framework (49:00)

**Scott Bailey**
Draft an initial elevator pitch script incorporating the top differentiators for internal review; develop supporting messaging architecture (50:17)
